 Election Day 2026: Photos from around the country : The Picture Show Voters across the country are heading to the polls today to cast their ballots in the 2026 midterm elections. 
 The Picture Show 
 Photo Stories From NPR 
 Instagram 
 The Picture Show 
 Election Day 2026: Photos from around the country
 November 3, 2026 7:00 PM ET 
 By 
 Meredith Nierman
 Against a backdrop of deep political division and with the control of Congress at stake, voters across the country are heading to the polls today to cast their ballots for the 2026 midterm elections. From lines at polling stations to the anticipation and reactions as the results come in, NPR station photographers are documenting the election in their communities.
 Voters fill out their ballots at Chicago's McKinley Park Library.

 Peg Ihinger takes a photo as she leaves her early voting sticker at the memorial for Alex Pretti in Minneapolis. "I just want this nightmare to end for our city and our country," Ihinger said. "And damn it, they shouldn't have died." Pretti and Renée Good, both 37 and residents of Minneapolis, were killed in separate incidents by U.S. Customs and Border Protection officers and Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents during the Trump administration's Operation Metro Surge in January.
